items.title: Darnell Howard Interview, 1957-04-21
items.q: I remember Ralph Emerson Brown playing saxophone. I was doubling on the fiddle and the clarinet... But we were playing in the Scheller Cafe

ctx.x: Yes. When did you last see General Orton? By what? When did you last see General Orton? Oh boy. I don't remember that.

Yes I do. We were playing at a place on 31st Street. He wasn't playing though. I don't remember where he was playing at the time, but I remember him coming down there, I remember Ralph Emerson Brown playing saxophone. I was doubling on the fiddle and the clarinet. I don't remember who the piano player was, there was about five of us. This was you? This was? It wasn't my band, no. No, no. But we were playing in the Scheller Cafe that's at 31st Street, almost two blocks across the street from the Royal Gardens.…
How old he dressed, do you remember?
